questions.stem: In a transverse wave, how do the particle oscillations relate to the direction of energy transfer?

options.text: Parallel to the direction of energy transfer
Perpendicular to the direction of energy transfer
At 45 degrees to the direction of energy transfer
In the same direction as the wave but opposite way

questions.explanation: In a transverse wave, the oscillations are perpendicular (at right angles) to the direction of energy transfer. For example, in a wave on a rope, the rope moves up and down while the wave travels horizontally.
